notes:
- 新增每会话统计页：离线统计、日期筛选、动态图表、深浅主题与原消息下钻；包含活跃度、类型、时段、发送者、连续聊天、讨论片段、文字长度、引用、文件和文字表情。系统通知单列、发送者按身份区分，记录覆盖范围明确展示。
- Add local per-conversation statistics with date filters, animated theme-aware charts and message drilldowns. Cover activity, types, hours, participants, streaks, discussion segments, text lengths, quotes, files and inline emoji. Separate system events, preserve sender identity and show archive coverage.

- 统计页沿用微信绿配色，支持深浅主题、日期切换和图表动效；同排卡片等高、图表自适应，系统减少动态效果设置生效。提供同源合成演示，修正搜索分页测试对小样本的假设。
- Use WeChat-green, light/dark themes, animated date transitions and equal-height responsive cards; honor reduced motion. Add consistent synthetic chart/drilldown fixtures and validate paginated search with larger datasets.
- 统计仅在已解锁的本地资料库中执行，不向 AI 提供额外工具；按北京时间划分日期，限定账号和会话，超限报错而不返回不完整总量。Windows 本地测试与浏览器验收已完成；Linux/macOS 原生能力未在本机验证。本版仅发布 Windows x64 安装包，WebView2 仍复用系统运行时、缺失时下载。
- Aggregate only inside the unlocked local vault without exposing new AI tools; use UTC+8 boundaries, account/conversation isolation and explicit errors for oversized ranges. Verified locally on Windows and in the browser; Linux/macOS native behavior is not established by these checks. Publish Windows x64 only and reuse WebView2, downloading it only when missing.
